dag_infos.description: New Taipei City marriage and divorce participant counts by five-year age band, sex, marriage type, original nationality and education, from MOI Household Registration open data ODRP069 and ODRP071. The raw bands support an apportioned 18-35 interpretation with single-age population weights, but no derived 18-35 value is written here; confidence is low because the source is an event/person count rather than a population count.

data_infos.name_cn: 新北市結婚與離婚人數（按年齡組、性別、行政區）
data_infos.source_type: 內政部戶政司 RIS OpenData API (ODRP069 / ODRP071)
data_infos.dataset_description: ODRP069為按發生日期分的結婚人數，ODRP071為按發生日期分的離婚／終止結婚人數；兩者都按行政區、婚姻類型、性別、原屬國籍、教育程度與5歲年齡組提供資料。本DAG以indicator_id區分 marriage_count 與 divorce_count，保留來源年齡組，不把5歲組誤當單齡。18至35需以同區、同年、同性別的單齡人口權重分攤15至19及35至39兩個邊界組；由於被分攤的是事件／人數，不是人口，18至35結果屬低信心 apportioned。實測結婚涵蓋民國109至114年（西元2020至2025），離婚涵蓋民國111至114年（西元2022至2025）。
data_infos.etl_description: Fetch ODRP069 and ODRP071 with a browser User-Agent, COUNTY=新北市, and all responseData pages. Discover each dataset in both directions from ROC 114 and stop only after two consecutive OD-0102-S no-data years. RIS no-data is HTTP 200 plus OD-0102-S, so responseCode is authoritative. Normalise fields by role aliases: ODRP069 uses year/number_of_marry in most observed years but statistic_yyy/marry_count in ROC 113; ODRP071 uses statistic_yyy/divorce_count. Parse every age label into integer lower/upper bounds and raise on an unknown label. Fill missing dimension keys before groupby and use dropna=False so pandas cannot silently drop a category. Aggregate duplicate source rows by district, age band, sex, marriage type, nation, education and basis, then reconcile the aggregated value sum to the input value sum for every source-year. No 18-35 value is fabricated in this DAG; downstream population-weight apportionment must preserve its low-confidence assumption.
